original_test_intent: Collect the owner-approved PCIe device inventory scope for the selected System—either the complete collection or one explicitly scoped member—and validate identity, completeness and approved fields without changing PCIe state.
original_method: Resolve the System and PCIe collection, record its count/member set, obtain the owner's full-versus-member decision, then use trusted curl/jq to read the chosen bounded resource, validate scope-specific completeness/schema/identity and export redacted evidence.
manual_activity: The platform owner declares whether inventory means every PCIe collection member or one named device, supplies expected population/field rules, and approves retention/redaction of serial, address, vendor/device and topology data.

curl and jq on approved agent host

GET bounded collection or exact member

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The single-member URI is valid only for an explicitly selected device. It cannot support the plural inventory claim without collection enumeration, and fixed parent/free-form ID, `-k` and raw output leave identity and privacy unproven.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: First enumerate the validated System PCIe collection, then according to the approved scope either validate every bounded unique member or one named collection-derived member, enforcing schema/completeness and redacting restricted device/topology identifiers.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The read-only PCIe inventory context and 15/10 timing remain; no full-versus-member scope, expected count, member ID or inventory field is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Make population scope an explicit input, anchor it to the collection member set, and apply a different completeness oracle for full inventory versus one-device inspection.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Preserves the title/path conflict instead of labeling one JSON object complete inventory; adds scope, count/link, identity and privacy validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Full scope covers all current collection members; member scope covers only one approved device and must be reported as partial by design.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BMC inventory can lag host enumeration and may expose devices/functions differently. A correct full Redfish collection still does not prove negotiated link performance or driver binding.

project_override_considerations: If the owner selects one member, evidence must explicitly say single-member inspection and cannot satisfy full inventory. Host `lspci` can be a separately approved reconciliation source but cannot redefine Redfish collection completeness.
expected_evidence: Owner-approved inventory scope and immutable BMC/System identity
Validated PCIe collection link, current count and member set
Firmware/schema and expected population or member oracle
HTTP status/content type and restricted raw hashes
Redacted approved device/function metadata and no-mutation audit

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master title requests plural PCIe Devices Inventory, while its Procedure reads exactly one `{PCIeId}` member and supplies no statement that a single device is the intended inventory. This can silently produce incomplete evidence and must be resolved by the owner.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Both safe interpretations are identifiable. An owner scope decision plus schema/count/privacy policy is a concrete prerequisite, after which the corresponding read-only workflow is executable.

review_improvement: Exposes the plural-inventory versus one-member mismatch and adds scope-specific completeness, identity and privacy controls.
independent_technical_reasoning: Inventory is a statement about a defined population. Reading `/PCIe/{PCIeId}` verifies at most one resource and cannot detect missing siblings, duplicates or an unexpected collection count. The collection must therefore be enumerated even when the final approved scope is one member, because that proves membership and makes the limitation explicit. If full inventory is intended, every bounded unique member needs reconciliation; otherwise the result must be labeled partial rather than passed as complete.
